2608.21060.title: CellPath-Bench: A Multidimensional Benchmark for Whole-Slide Cellular Representations in Pathology Foundation Models
2608.21060.paper_summary: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) are increasingly used as general-purpose backbones, yet existing benchmarks cannot systematically diagnose their whole-slide cellular representation capabilities, including the decodability of cell-type information and the transferability of such information across tissue sections, datasets, and anatomical organs. We introduce CellPath-Bench, a cellular-resolution benchmark that evaluates frozen PFMs themselves. Following quality control of 52 candidate Xenium datasets, we construct a panel of 25 spatially aligned H\&E--Xenium tissue sections spanning 11 organs and 7,079,283 cells, harmonized into fine- and coarse-grained taxonomies. CellPath-Bench samples frozen WSI feature maps at registered nuclear coordinates and evaluates them using standardized multiclass linear probes. Cell Representation Advantage (CRA) measures the within-section advantage of nucleus-anchored representations over patch-level mean pooling, while Cell Representation Transferability (CRT) characterizes the generalization of cell-type decodability across tissue sections, datasets, and organs. We benchmark 30 pathology-specific and general-purpose foundation models through 304,920 runs across spatial readouts, magnifications, taxonomic granularities, and evaluation protocols. The results reveal substantial model-dependent differences in cell-type decodability and its cross-domain generalization, yielding distinct multidimensional capability profiles. CellPath-Bench provides a standardized framework for auditing cellular information in frozen PFM representations.
2608.21060.paper_summary_zh: 病理基礎模型（PFMs）越來越多地被用作通用骨幹，但現有的基準無法系統性地診斷它們的全切片細胞表徵能力，包括細胞類型信息的可解碼性以及這種信息在組織切片、數據集和解剖器官之間的可轉移性。<lb/>我們介紹了CellPath-Bench，一個評估冷凍PFMs本身的細胞解析度基準。在對52個候選Xenium數據集進行質量控制後，我們構建了一個涵蓋11個器官和7,079,283個細胞的25個空間對齊的H\&E--Xenium組織切片面板，並將其協調成細粒度和粗粒度的分類。<lb/>CellPath-Bench在註冊的細胞核坐標上對冷凍WSI特徵圖進行取樣，並使用標準化的多類線性探針對其進行評估。<lb/>細胞表徵優勢（CRA）衡量了以細胞核為錨的表徵相對於補丁級均值池化的區域內優勢，而細胞表徵可轉移性（CRT）則表徵了細胞類型可解碼性在組織切片、數據集和器官之間的泛化。<lb/>我們通過304,920次運行在空間讀出、放大倍率、分類顆粒度和評估協議上對30個病理特定和通用基礎模型進行基準測試。<lb/>結果顯示細胞類型可解碼性及其跨領域泛化存在顯著的模型依賴性差異，產生了不同的多維能力輪廓。<lb/>CellPath-Bench提供了一個標準化框架，用於審核冷凍PFM表徵中的細胞信息。
